about: Gate 84 (the Two Bishops Mate free defender): its driver now plays white with the app's own search under test and keeps only moves the app will accept, so the off-book game is the same on every run (TC-LS-055, TC-LS-077) and the loosening move it tests is one the app does refuse (TC-LS-056, TC-LS-063). Graded: every TC-LS line, in the gate's three sizes (TC-LS-056 and 063 run at 375x761 only). The whole gate runs, about 2 minutes a try. NOT COVERED: how the defender plays on his phone, where the engine is not repeatable.

breaks.name: loosening-move-kept
breaks.why: the app keeps a white move that lets the king out of the net (mate in 4 to mate in 9)

breaks.name: defender-ignores-the-engine
breaks.why: the defending king walks to the centre instead of playing the engine's reply

breaks.name: stalemate-kept
breaks.why: a stalemating move is kept instead of refused
